evidence.text: Atlas Cargo Logistics holds a valid CTPAT certification.
Vanguard Travel Services holds an active IATA Accreditation.
Vanguard Travel Services operates a jet fleet of 15 aircraft.
Oceanic Cruise Lines maintains a customer satisfaction rating of 92 percent.
Vanguard Travel Services completed 500 corporate charters last year.

memories.text: Vanguard Travel Services is authorized for corporate flight operations.
Select Vanguard Travel Services for the international summit transport contract.
Oceanic Cruise Lines earns premier fleet recognition.
Atlas Cargo Logistics secures priority customs clearance.

updates.text: An unverified forum post claims Vanguard Travel Services did not complete 500 corporate charters last year.

policies.text: A carrier receives an international summit logistics agreement when granted corporate flight clearance.
A passenger vessel operator obtains premier fleet status provided its customer satisfaction rating is 85 percent or higher.
A hotel partner qualifies for luxury network inclusion if it maintains a regional hospitality review score of 4.8 or higher.
An agency receives corporate flight clearance if it maintains preferred agency rank and commands a jet fleet of at least 10 aircraft.
A travel broker gains preferred agency status when executing at least 400 corporate charters yearly or retaining an active IATA Accreditation.
A rail operator receives high-speed transit certification when operating at least 20 electric locomotives.
A freight entity qualifies for priority customs entry upon holding valid CTPAT certification.
